voice._micSource_help: PipeWire source to listen on. Empty = use the speaker's own Bluetooth HFP mic (switches the speaker to HFP to listen, then back to A2DP to play). On a Raspberry Pi the onboard-BT HFP mic is often silent, so set this to a USB mic's source name (see `pactl list sources short`) - that also lets it listen WHILE music plays, since there's no A2DP/HFP conflict.
